## Protocol versions

| Name | Value | Where it is on the wire |
| --- | --- | --- |
| v1 control handshake | `LINUX_LINK_HELLO 1` | TCP greeting, `protocol::HANDSHAKE_HELLO` |
| v1 version | `1` | the `1` in the greeting above |
| KDE Connect identity `protocolVersion` | `1` | `kdeconnect.identity`, a separate namespace |
| Linux Link extension `llVersion` | `1` | every `kdeconnect.linuxlink.*` packet (R4 D4) |
| v2 negotiated range | `2-2` | `IdentityPacketV2` min/max, QUIC stream 0 |
| Control payload ceiling | `16777216` bytes | framed v2 control JSON |
| Ports | control `1716/tcp`, media `4716/udp` | `DEFAULT_CONTROL_PORT`, `DEFAULT_STREAMING_PORT` |

## Transports

| Id | What it carries | Address | ALPN | In this build | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tcp-v1` | KDE Connect-style control channel | `tcp://0.0.0.0:1716` | — | yes | plugin traffic (clipboard, battery, notifications, files); the plane Phase 3 retires |
| `quic-v2` | QUIC multiplexer: media + control | `udp://0.0.0.0:4716` | `linux-link-v2` | yes | negotiated over LAN addresses and tailnet IPs alike |
| `quic-v1-stream` | QUIC streaming (pre-v2 handshake) | `udp://0.0.0.0:4716` | `linux-link-stream` | yes | offered on the same port; the server dispatches on the ALPN the peer picks |
| `iroh-noq` | iroh hole-punched WAN endpoint | `address-free (endpoint id over any link)` | `linux-link-v2` | yes | behind the `wan` feature; the Android bridge builds with it |

## Capture backends

`Auto` attempts, in order: Wayland `screencopy -> portal`, X11 `x11`.

| Backend | `capture_backend` value | Auto rank (Wayland) | Auto rank (X11) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Screencopy` | `"screencopy"` | 1 | not tried |
| `Portal` | `"portal"` | 2 | not tried |
| `X11` | `"x11"` | not tried | 1 |
